blocker.detail: After the target-event index and contract-projection cache, all 177 unary operations complete and the joint path runs at approximately 4.5-10 seconds per operation. The remaining 15,545 joint operations plus the consumer conditional still project to roughly 20-43 hours on the shared 16 GiB host, without a bounded batch native owner. A full run is therefore stopped rather than reported as complete; the durable receipts can resume only the completed 208 operations. The remaining work is a material batch-execution architecture change or an explicitly reduced declared pairwise frontier.

The existing per-operation path cannot complete the full frontier in a practical finite window on this host.
